author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit has flagged a critical gap in our consent records for loyalty basket data. I am prepared to release a portion of my compliance budget to accelerate the remediation work. In exchange, I require the data contracts to be fully automated and governed so that consent checks are enforced before any record enters the pipeline. This trade ensures we clear the audit without waiting for manual sign offs. If we do not automate these checks, we cannot safely proceed with using this data in forecasts. I am willing to spend the funds now to secure a robust, auditable foundation for the entire system.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly offers up a portion of their compliance budget in exchange for the automation of data contracts, clearly stating what they are willing to give up to achieve the desired outcome.
